job: Work through a queue: pick a record from a list and read or act on it beside the list.
purpose: Two panes: a list of rows (buttons with data-value) and the record that is open. The open row has aria-current="true" and the accent wash. Panels in the main pane with a matching data-detail are shown for you, or the page renders the record on fd:select. Below 760px of its own width one pane shows at a time (data-view="list|detail"): focus moves to the record's heading, and the back button returns it to the row.
useWhen: People decide or review records one after another: requests, approvals, failures, messages.
The list must stay in view while one record is open, and a phone shows the list first.

avoidWhen.when: Each record needs its own page and address.
The side pane is settings navigation.
The detail is a short summary over the page.

states.name: list
states.how: data-view="list" (the default): below 760px only the list shows

states.name: detail
states.how: data-view="detail": below 760px only the record shows, with fd-list-detail-back

states.name: loading
states.how: aria-busy="true" on the root with skeletons in both panes

states.name: empty
states.how: an fd-empty in place of the whole layout

variants.useWhen: Rendering a page whose address names one record, so a phone opens on it.

parts.role: The root: two columns, one pane at a time below 760px of its own width.
The list pane: a heading and an fd-list (or cards) of rows with data-value.
The record pane: the back button and the record, or [data-detail] panels.
The way back to the list, shown only when one pane shows; put it on an fd-back button.

keyboard.does: On a row: opens its record; on a phone focus moves to the record's heading.
On the back button: returns to the list with focus on the open row.
